about_the_game:
Legend has it that over 1,000 mischievous cats have scattered themselves in the world’s most famous landmarks—and it’s your mission to find them all. From Berlin’s graffiti-lined streets to Kyoto’s serene shrines, explore 10+ hand-drawn maps, hunt together with a friend, and color each scene in a soothing, mindful setting.

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE

  • Cultural Touches
    Every map brims with local architecture, street stalls, and folklore nods—immerse yourself in each region’s unique vibe.

  • Mindful Coloring
    Unwind with guided color-by-numbers or switch to free mode and craft your own palette.

  • 1,000+ Cats & 10+ Maps
    Challenge yourself to spot every cat across a dozen-plus scenic locales.

  • Play with a Friend
    Team up in cozy local co-op: share color picks, compete on the leaderboard, and earn joint achievements.

  • Relaxing Atmosphere
    Gentle lo-fi beats and ambient sounds keep you calm as you explore and create.

  • Community Gallery
    Share your masterpieces, vote on others’ art, and join monthly themed contests.


Life can be hectic—take a break with 100 CATS LOST IN WORLD: FIND & COLOR. This cozy puzzle-coloring game hides over 1,000 cats in more than 10 tranquil maps. Team up with a friend or go solo, then color your way through each scene at your own pace in a peaceful, soothing atmosphere.

FEATURES AT A GLANCE

  • 1,000+ Hidden Cats: Hunt through every corner for clever feline surprises.

  • 10+ Beautiful Maps: From bustling markets to quiet temples, explore diverse locales.

  • Cozy Co-op: Relax together in local two-player mode or Remote Play Together.

  • Guided & Free Coloring: Choose number-based palettes for stress relief or freestyle your own colors.

  • Calm Vibes: Ambient soundtrack and soft UI create the perfect chill-out experience.

  • Accessible Design: Intuitive controls, adjustable zoom, and color-blind-friendly palettes.
